messages:
Olivia (CS): planning a TWILIGHT APAC office-hours run to cover APAC-friendly times + bilingual support (EN/JP). target next Tue 19:00 JST. 60m slot: 35m demo + 25m hands-on breakout. sign-up: https://rwd.link/apac-twilight :sparkles:

Jamal (APAC CS): happy to co-host. i'll do Japanese intro and help with sandbox provisioning for Japan customers. can we offer a pre-provisioned trial workspace?

Sana (Onboarding): we can create 10 trial sandboxes. propose a signup cutoff 48h prior and require one admin contact per org. will add provisioning checklist to the invite.

Priya (Solutions): recommend one breakout room for renewal-risk customers (billing/topology). i'll slot time for a 10m micro-triage. also suggest a short runbook for common infra fixes.

Olivia (CS): draft agenda below 

```
1) 5m - welcome + bilingual note
2)10m - quickstart + sandbox access
3)15m - live demo: routing & cost levers
4)10m - breakout: migration / renewal triage
5)20m - hands-on Q&A (support staff in rooms)
```

Jamal (APAC CS): can we enable live captions and have translated slides (JP)? i can translate 5 key slides.

EnablementBot: RSVP update: Olivia, Jamal, Sana, Priya. Sandboxes available: 10. Seats left: 8 orgs.

Olivia (CS): logistics: i'll create calendar invite with separate breakout rooms and attach translated slides. Sana to handle sandbox provisioning and follow-up email w/ links within 24h of session. post-session: short feedback form (2 questions) + recording (transcript).

Sana (Onboarding): noted. will include "bring API key, sample prompt, and expected throughput" line in pre-read.

Priya (Solutions): i'll prepare a 2-slide renewal triage checklist and post it here.

Olivia (CS): perfect. final rule: prioritize renewal-flagged orgs for the reserved breakout. i'll run sign-up review 24h before. thanks team :raised_hands:
